sources.title: Air quality
sources.role: Planning guidance for considering air-quality effects of development.
sources.facts: An AQMA, model or assessment input does not by itself prove exact-site exposure, significance or an application outcome.
sources.guard: Air-quality, noise, vibration and light records do not by themselves prove exact exposure, nuisance, permit compliance, ecological effect, mitigation adequacy or planning outcome.

sources.title: Air pollution and development: advice for local authorities
sources.role: Natural England standing advice for proposals affecting protected sites.
sources.facts: Standing advice and screening steps are not a project-specific habitats conclusion or approval.
sources.guard: Air-quality, noise, vibration and light records do not by themselves prove exact exposure, nuisance, permit compliance, ecological effect, mitigation adequacy or planning outcome.

sources.title: Air quality Environment Act target delivery plan
sources.role: Updated 2026 delivery plan for statutory and interim PM2.5 targets.
sources.facts: National targets and measured trajectories do not establish parcel-level concentration or compliance.
sources.guard: Air-quality, noise, vibration and light records do not by themselves prove exact exposure, nuisance, permit compliance, ecological effect, mitigation adequacy or planning outcome.

sources.title: National Planning Policy Framework - Conserving and enhancing the natural environment
sources.role: National policy covering noise, tranquil areas, light and air quality.
sources.facts: Policy criteria require local evidence and do not determine significance or mitigation for a particular proposal.
sources.guard: Air-quality, noise, vibration and light records do not by themselves prove exact exposure, nuisance, permit compliance, ecological effect, mitigation adequacy or planning outcome.

sources.title: Noise
sources.role: Planning guidance on noise-sensitive and noise-generating development.
sources.facts: Guidance states numerical criteria are not fixed universal thresholds; a site-specific acoustic assessment remains necessary.
sources.guard: Air-quality, noise, vibration and light records do not by themselves prove exact exposure, nuisance, permit compliance, ecological effect, mitigation adequacy or planning outcome.

sources.title: Light pollution
sources.role: Planning guidance on obtrusive light, amenity, wildlife and dark landscapes.
sources.facts: Lighting sensitivity and design factors do not prove nuisance, ecological harm or acceptable conditions at an exact site.
sources.guard: Air-quality, noise, vibration and light records do not by themselves prove exact exposure, nuisance, permit compliance, ecological effect, mitigation adequacy or planning outcome.

sources.title: Noise and vibration management: environmental permits
sources.role: Current Environment Agency guidance for permit applications and compliance evidence.
sources.facts: A noise plan or assessment submission is not evidence that a permit was issued or that conditions are being met.
sources.guard: Air-quality, noise, vibration and light records do not by themselves prove exact exposure, nuisance, permit compliance, ecological effect, mitigation adequacy or planning outcome.

sources.title: England (exc. London) Policy Guidance
sources.role: Current statutory LAQM policy guidance for English local authorities outside London.
sources.facts: LAQM duties, AQMAs and action plans are area-level management evidence, not exact-site monitoring or planning approval.
sources.guard: Air-quality, noise, vibration and light records do not by themselves prove exact exposure, nuisance, permit compliance, ecological effect, mitigation adequacy or planning outcome.
